scheme.title: Data Kind
scheme.description: What kind of data a data entry leads to. Drives the 'data type' facet and which detail block applies.

concepts.label: Raster
concepts.description: Gridded data: GeoTIFF/COG, NetCDF, Zarr, Earth Engine images.

concepts.label: Vector
concepts.description: Points, lines or polygons: Shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, FlatGeobuf.

concepts.label: Tabular
concepts.description: Tables: CSV, Excel, Parquet, with or without a geometry column.

concepts.label: Document
concepts.description: A report, plan or article meant to be read (PDF, Word, web page).

concepts.label: Mixed
concepts.description: Several kinds of data behind one access point; describe them in the description.

concepts.label: Other
concepts.description: Anything else (code, model files...); say what in the description.
